_doc: Hand fixes for places no pipeline rule handles. dual.skipWays: OSM way pairs dual.py must not collapse. roads: ops applied by refine_roads.mjs before its engine loop, on converter ids (build_roads.py output, OSM-based and stable). Ops: merge-nodes {nodes:[keep, ...], at?:[x,z]}, drop-road {road}, set-node {node, set}, set-road {road, set} (a null value removes that key, e.g. lanes: null = type default). Every op needs a 'why'. Check with tools/plot_area.mjs.

roads.why: Avenue du Prince de Ligne, east end of the island (H3, x 1673 z 362): three nodes within 12 m joined by 7-20 m one-way stubs; one junction.
Avenue du Prince de Ligne, west end of the island (H3, x 1595 z 362): a 40 m mini-island of two opposite one-ways; keep one as a two-way road.
See the drop of r27861175_0: this half becomes a plain two-way avenue (type default lanes).
Brugmann/Wolvendael roundabout (C2, x -641 z -313): unnamed service alley through the ring's centre; blocks folding the Brugmann junction into the ring.
Same service alley as r306595481_0, other half.
Brugmann/Wolvendael roundabout, south side (C2, x -600 z -260): unnamed one-way service loop next to the Wolvendael junction; makes the ring join cross roads.
Avenue Wolvendael (C2, x -578 z -150): the dual stretch splits and its two one-way halves meet again 20 m later; one node instead of a 20 m mini-island.
